name: fallow
description: Local-first codebase intelligence for TypeScript and JavaScript using fallow

interface.longDescription: Fallow gives Codex fast, local code health for TypeScript and JavaScript. Open the Fallow dashboard from the sidebar or beside a thread to see the health score, dead code, unused dependencies, duplication, complexity hotspots and architecture problems. Select findings to attach them to the composer, mention a finding with @Fallow, or let Codex fix them after it verifies each one. Audit a branch before a commit, plan a cleanup in a form, edit .fallowrc.json with rule controls and an impact preview, and browse any .sarif report. The skills also set up or modernize the quality stack of a project: keep the formatter and linter it already uses, write a Fallow config, add a code-health gate to CI, and make the repository agent-ready. Analysis runs locally with the fallow CLI. Optional cloud and product telemetry workflows run only after explicit user action.
defaultPrompt: Show the code health of this project.
Audit this branch before I commit.
Set up code quality tooling for this TypeScript project.
